CheckDialog.Title: Check: {aspect}
CheckDialog.StrainedHint: This Aspect is Strained: the Check includes at least 1 Flaw.
CheckDialog.PermanentFlawHint: This character has 3 or more Wounds: the Check includes at least 1 Flaw (a source distinct from Aspect Strain).
CheckDialog.FacingEvilHint: The character directly interacts with the evil: the Host adds an Omen Die to the Check, on top of the dice drawn from the bag. It counts as a Flaw and must be rolled.
CheckDialog.HarmlessHint: Harmless Check: an Omen Die at or under the current Act gives no Wound, but a Strain on the rolled Aspect.

Sheet.Name: Name
Sheet.WoundsHint: Number of Omen Dice currently in front of this character
Sheet.PerkStrainHint: Strained Perk (visual only, no mechanical effect)
Sheet.NoRatingWarning: Choose a Rating for this Aspect first.
Sheet.GearTagHint: Click: make a Check with this item (+1 Edge) · Right-click: options
Sheet.GearBrokenHint: Broken or lost: using it gives a Flaw · Right-click: options
Sheet.GearUse: Make a Check with this item

StoryAspectsDialog.Title: Story Aspects
StoryAspectsDialog.Hint: Set the 5 Story Aspects for this scenario.

Bourse.WaitingForGM: Waiting for a connected Host to create the Dice Bag.
Bourse.NotReady: The Dice Bag hasn't been created yet. Log in as the Host to initialize it.
Bourse.HostOnly: Only the Host can do this.
Bourse.NotOwner: You can only adjust Wounds for your own characters.
Bourse.ActHintProlog: The Host always adds 1 Omen Die at the end of the Prologue.
Bourse.CheatDeathDieHint: Safe Die spent on a Cheat Death
Bourse.FatalWound: Fatal Wound: the last Omen Die means death or despair
Bourse.CheatDeathStoryUsed: This character already cheated death this story.
Bourse.CheatDeathActUsed: The table already cheated death this Act.
Bourse.NoSafeDiceLeft: No Safe Dice left in the bag.
Bourse.NoWoundToCheat: This character has no Wound to replace with a Safe Die.
Bourse.OutOfStory: This character no longer takes part in the story.
Bourse.SuccumbConfirm: {name} succumbs to their wounds or to despair. All the dice in front of this character return to the bag. Continue?
Bourse.Resurrect: Bring back into the story (fully restored)
Bourse.NewStoryConfirm: Reset the bag (8 Safe Dice, no Omen Dice, Prologue) and fully restore every character: no Wounds, Cheat Death or Strain. Ratings, Perks and Gear are kept. Continue?
Bourse.ChooseCharactersHint: Tick the characters playing this story: only they appear in the Dice Bag.
Bourse.NoParticipantsGM: No character chosen. Use the button next to the title to pick the story's characters.

Chat.StrainSuggested: Harmless Check: no Wound, but a Strain on {aspect}.
Chat.CheatDeathAnnounce: {name} cheats Death! Be careful... there is one less Safe Die in the bag now!
Chat.SuccumbAnnounce: {name} succumbs... All their dice return to the bag.
Chat.SacrificeAnnounce: {name} valiantly sacrifices themselves for the others: {aspect} automatically succeeds. All their dice return to the bag.

Sacrifice.Title: Valiant Sacrifice?
Sacrifice.Hint: {name} is at death's door and drew an Omen Die. Sacrifice: no roll, the Check automatically succeeds, but the character leaves the story and all their dice return to the bag.
